admission.native_initialization: real factory and OnPostInit, exact live Game world, component-only prefab
admission.input: FindComponent absence is mandatory before any action; no input/gadget/controller/keybinding component or fake provider
admission.ui_result: actual Open return; true may be degraded HasMap false; harness failure is never false Open
admission.numeric: actual rounded finite dt/accumulator text; explicit tolerance required; no exact binary32/signed-zero claim
admission.teardown: actual world SwitchToEditMode must deliver two OnDelete callbacks; no manual callbacks or deletion API
admission.retention: observer must not add strong UI, widget, screen or component retention; no physical allocator/lifetime proof

branches.open_true: FOCUSED, native frames, duplicate refusal, close/reopen, queued method observations, focused teardown
branches.open_false: HELD retained and real false observed; focused/UI suite unavailable, never invent success

progress: first and reopen waits require two selected-owner focused native frames and both actual deferred-method exits at action_count2 or5; no per-enqueue/FIFO/rendering claim
queue_scope: unchanged CallLater enqueue and actual method entry/exit observations only; no verified per-enqueue origin, FIFO, cancellation, frame pacing, receiver retirement or physical release claim
checksum: 31 multiplier modulo1000003 over retained printable ASCII row plus LF; columns strict by row kind
required_evidence: two actual deletion entries and pre-super boundaries
